- `GET /coins-v2/user-created-coins/{user-created-coinToken}` — Get user-created coin details.
- `GET /following/followers/{followerToken}` — Get a list of followers for a specific user.
- `GET /moderation/ban/address/{addressToken}` — Check if an address is banned.

### Data Read (5)

- `GET /api/v1/apps/cm1p2gzot03fzqty5xzgjgthq` — Retrieve data for a specific application.

- `GET /docs/{docId}` — Retrieve a specific document from the platform's documentation.
- `GET /v3/wallets` — Retrieve a list of wallets associated with the platform.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /` — Create or update data on the platform.
- `POST /api/v1/analytics_events` — Send analytics events to the platform.
- `POST /ingestion/{ingestionId}` — Ingest data into the platform.
- `POST /v1/coins/{coinId}/batch` — Perform batch operations on a coin.
